node.title: XR mismatch-descent dimension area law
node.statement: For every live invariant-excess mismatch chain, sum_j(K_j+h)<=N_0-(h+1), while the external-zero drops telescope as sum_j d_j=K_0-K_L<=K_0-1. Consequently the number of levels with K_j>=kappa is at most floor((N_0-h-1)/(kappa+h)), and a chain close to maximal depth has only the corresponding small excess-dimension area. Exact caps are printed for all six clean-rate roots. This is pathwise dimension amortization, not a branch-width or slope payment.
